About the Project

The Citizen-Centred Artificial Intelligence CDT places people and communities at the centre of AI research. Its doctoral training route is designed around the development and use of AI systems, with funding terms that differ between home and international applicants.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Human-centred technology
  • Computer science

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryHome: GBP 30,000/year (2027/28); international: UKRI rate
DurationFour years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsNorthumbria-led four-year programme; enhanced home and standard international stipend differ.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 12 October 2026
Deadline / consideration round11 January 2027
LocationUnited Kingdom

About Northumbria University

Northumbria is a UK university with postgraduate research across its academic schools. It leads the Citizen-Centred Artificial Intelligence doctoral training programme, bringing research in AI together with questions about its use in society.
